description: This file defines the NotificationQueueService class which manages enqueueing, processing, and sending email notifications within a Spring Boot application. It handles scheduled processing, external email service integration, and includes access control annotations.

classes.name: NotificationQueueService
classes.description: Service for managing notification queue including enqueueing, scheduled processing, and sending notifications.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueue a new email notification with specified details.

methods.name: listRecent
methods.description: Retrieve the most recent notifications up to the specified limit.

methods.name: processQueue
methods.description: Scheduled method that processes queued notifications in batches.

methods.name: attemptSend
methods.description: Attempts to send a notification; simulates send if mail is disabled.

methods.name: handleFailure
methods.description: Handles retries and failure state for a notification after a send failure.
